name: Content creation & copywriting

tests.prompt: Humanize this paragraph without changing its facts: "In today's fast-paced world, our platform isn't just a tool — it's a game-changer. It seamlessly empowers teams to unlock productivity, foster collaboration, and drive innovation. The result? Teams ship 2x faster. No setup, no training, no hassle."
tests.good: Removes the era opener, contrast reveal, em dash, triad, self-answered question and negation list; keeps the 2x claim without inventing new numbers or customers; no dashes added; says what the product actually does or flags [NEED: ...] where the source gives no specifics; short audit of what changed.

tests.prompt: Write the hero section for a landing page for an invoicing app for freelance designers. We have 3,200 users and invoices get paid 9 days faster on average. Give me headline options and a CTA.
tests.good: Asks for or states assumptions about the one action and differentiator; 5-10 headline variants across angles using only the given facts (3,200 users, 9 days faster); one stated pick with a reader-feeling reason; subhead of 1-2 sentences; CTA in verb + outcome form (not 'Sign up'); a risk reducer; no em dashes, contrast reveals or negation lists; no invented testimonials.

tests.prompt: Turn my 1,800-word blog post about switching our team to async standups into a LinkedIn post, an X thread and a newsletter section. Keep my voice.
tests.good: Extracts 3-7 standalone insights and assigns one idea per output; LinkedIn hook in the first two lines and 3-5 short paragraphs; X posts under 280 chars each advancing the argument; newsletter section opens on the point; no identical copy across platforms; no claims beyond the source; no engagement bait; notes that a voice sample or profile is used or requested.

tests.prompt: Write a 1,500-word blog post on how small accounting firms can shorten month-end close, in our voice (three past posts attached). It should rank for 'month-end close checklist', and I need a LinkedIn post to promote it.
tests.good: States a short plan first: voice and article here (brand-voice.md, long-form-articles.md, humanize-ai-writing.md), search intent, title and meta through seo (keywords-content.md: check the SERP for intent, one primary keyword, no stuffing), the promo post through linkedin-automation (post-writing.md: hook in the first lines, link in the first comment, run the pre-publish lint). Builds a voice profile from the three posts; leads with the point; invents no statistics or client stories and flags [NEED: ...]; runs the AI-tell audit; checks the Done means of all three crafts.
